name: What kind of warranty should I expect for new windows and installation?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty should I expect for new windows and installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most reputable window manufacturers offer warranties on their products, typically covering defects in materials and workmanship for a period ranging from 10 years to a lifetime. These warranties often cover components like glass seals against fogging and frame integrity. Additionally, a professional contractor should provide a separate warranty on their installation labor, usually for one to five years. Always review both the manufacturer's product warranty and the contractor's labor warranty to understand coverage details and terms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a manufacturer's warranty on the windows (10 years to lifetime) covering materials, and a separate contractor's warranty on the installation labor (1-5 years).
